module Fluent
  module RPC
    class Server
      def initialize(endpoint, log)
        bind, port = endpoint.split(':')
        @bind = bind
        @port = port
        @log = log

        @server = WEBrick::HTTPServer.new(
          BindAddress: @bind,
          Port: @port,
          Logger: WEBrick::Log.new(STDERR, WEBrick::Log::FATAL),
          AccessLog: [],
        )
        reset_handler_table
        self.class.collect_rpc_diagnostics(@bind, @port, false)
        @request_count = 0
        @last_error = nil
        @rpc_started = false
        @log.debug "rpc server prepared", bind: bind_for_log, port: port_value
      end

      def mount(path, servlet, *args)
        @server.mount(path, servlet, *args)
        record_handler_path(path, :servlet)
        @log.debug "register #{path} RPC servlet"
      end

      def mount_proc(path, &block)
        kind = self.class.rpc_path_kind(path)
        @server.mount_proc(path) { |req, res|
